using System;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Plugins.Core.CodeInterpreter;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Plugins.Core.CodeInterpreter.UnitTests;

public sealed class SessionsPythonPluginTests
{
    private readonly Mock<IHttpClientFactory> _httpClientFactoryMock = new();
    private readonly Mock<ILogger<SessionsPythonPlugin>> _loggerMock = new();
    private readonly SessionsPythonSettings _settings;

    public SessionsPythonPluginTests()
    {
        _settings = new SessionsPythonSettings
        {
            Endpoint = new Uri("https://example.com"),
            SanitizeInput = false
        };
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task ExecuteCodeAsync_LogsTraceMessage_WithProvidedCode()
    {
        // Arrange
        var code = "print(\"Hello, World!\")";
        var plugin = new SessionsPythonPlugin(_settings, _httpClientFactoryMock.Object, loggerFactory: new MockLoggerFactory(_loggerMock.Object));

        // Act
        await plugin.ExecuteCodeAsync(code);

        // Assert
        _loggerMock.Verify(
            x => x.LogTrace(
                It.Is<string>(s => s == "Executing Python code: {Code}"),
                It.Is<object[]>(args => args.Length == 1 && args[0].ToString() == code)),
            Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task ExecuteCodeAsync_LogsTraceMessage_AfterSanitization_WhenSanitizeInputIsTrue()
    {
        // Arrange
        var originalCode = "print(\"Hello, World!\")";
        var sanitizedCode = "print(\"Hello, World! (sanitized)\")";
        _settings.SanitizeInput = true;

        var mockPlugin = new Mock<SessionsPythonPlugin>(_settings, _httpClientFactoryMock.Object, null, new MockLoggerFactory(_loggerMock.Object));
        mockPlugin.Setup(p => p.SanitizeCodeInput(originalCode)).Returns(sanitizedCode);

        var plugin = mockPlugin.Object;

        // Act
        await plugin.ExecuteCodeAsync(originalCode);

        // Assert
        _loggerMock.Verify(
            x => x.LogTrace(
                It.Is<string>(s => s == "Executing Python code: {Code}"),
                It.Is<object[]>(args => args.Length == 1 && args[0].ToString() == sanitizedCode)),
            Times.Once);
    }

    private sealed class MockLoggerFactory : ILoggerFactory
    {
        private readonly Mock<ILogger<SessionsPythonPlugin>> _loggerMock;

        public MockLoggerFactory(Mock<ILogger<SessionsPythonPlugin>> loggerMock)
        {
            _loggerMock = loggerMock;
        }

        public void AddProvider(ILoggerProvider provider)
        {
        }

        public ILogger CreateLogger(string categoryName) => _loggerMock.Object;

        public void Dispose()
        {
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Net.Http;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Plugins.Core.CodeInterpreter;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Plugins.Core.CodeInterpreter.UnitTests;

public sealed class SessionsPythonPluginTests
{
    private readonly Mock<IHttpClientFactory> _httpClientFactoryMock;
    private readonly Mock<ILogger<SessionsPythonPlugin>> _loggerMock;
    private readonly SessionsPythonSettings _settings;

    public SessionsPythonPluginTests()
    {
        _httpClientFactoryMock = new Mock<IHttpClientFactory>();
        _loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<SessionsPythonPlugin>>();
        _settings = new SessionsPythonSettings("test-session", new Uri("https://example.com"));
        _settings.SanitizeInput = false;
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task ExecuteCodeAsync_LogsTraceMessage_WithProvidedCode()
    {
        // Arrange
        var code = "print(\"Hello, World!\")";
        var loggerFactory = new Mock<ILoggerFactory>();
        loggerFactory.Setup(f => f.CreateLogger(typeof(SessionsPythonPlugin).FullName)).Returns(_loggerMock.Object);
        var plugin = new SessionsPythonPlugin(_settings, _httpClientFactoryMock.Object, loggerFactory: loggerFactory.Object);

        // Act
        await plugin.ExecuteCodeAsync(code);

        // Assert
        _loggerMock.Verify(
            x => x.Log(
                It.Is<LogLevel>(l => l == LogLevel.Trace),
                It.Is<EventId>(e => e.Id == 0),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString()!.Contains("Executing Python code: {Code}")),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.Is<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>((v, t) => true)),
            Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task ExecuteCodeAsync_LogsTraceMessage_AfterSanitization_WhenSanitizeInputIsTrue()
    {
        // Arrange
        var code = "print(\"Hello, World!\")";
        _settings.SanitizeInput = true;

        // Mock the private SanitizeCodeInput method using reflection
        var plugin = new SessionsPythonPlugin(_settings, _httpClientFactoryMock.Object, loggerFactory: Mock.Of<ILoggerFactory>(f => f.CreateLogger(typeof(SessionsPythonPlugin).FullName) == _loggerMock.Object));
        var sanitizeMethod = typeof(SessionsPythonPlugin).GetMethod("SanitizeCodeInput", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)!;
        sanitizeMethod.Invoke(plugin, [code])!; // Trigger sanitization if needed

        // Act
        await plugin.ExecuteCodeAsync(code);

        // Assert - verify LogTrace was called with the (potentially sanitized) code
        _loggerMock.Verify(
            x => x.Log(
                It.Is<LogLevel>(l => l == LogLevel.Trace),
                It.Is<EventId>(e => e.Id == 0),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString()!.Contains("Executing Python code: {Code}")),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.Is<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>((v, t) => true)),
            Times.Once);
    }
}
